text_block_list.text: I'm walking Hishi Amazon through the training regimen, but something is really bugging me…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh, just bedhead—or bedtail, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It wasn't completely dry before I went to sleep last night. The younger students in the dorm had the same reaction as you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But yeah… stuff like this happens to the best of us. More importantly…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yawn… Huh, what was I talkin' about again?
Hishi Amazon looks like she's about to fall asleep any second. She must be exhausted. It might be best to adjust her race schedule.
